palm.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A newly generated seamless-feeling atmospheric BACKGROUND for a warm dreamy editorial personal website, no website layout or words. Match the mood of soft film photography with glowing amber light and poetic silhouettes: cream paper, pale caramel, muted burnt orange, warm gray shadows, delicate grain and strong optical blur. Understated, low contrast, mostly light ivory, large negative space. The motif must dissolve into the background with soft edges, never look like a cutout sticker. No text, typography, symbols, stars, borders, logos or watermark. Wide landscape composition. A softly luminous raised open human palm seen only as a diffuse shadow/silhouette through translucent paper, positioned on the left third, surrounded by dim orange-gold light like a hand reaching toward sunlight. Abstract and dreamy, anatomically plausible five fingers, no sharp skin detail. Right two thirds very pale cream with only faint warm light, for readable dark text.
